content:
Tomorrow is Apple's annual most important product launch event, with the market generally expecting new Apple Watch models to be unveiled. Surprisingly, Apple has already removed all models of the Apple Watch SE 3 from its official website.

Apple's official website shows that all Apple Watch SE 3 models are "currently out of stock".

The market generally expects Apple to launch new iPhone and Apple Watch models at its event on September 9, and may also announce other products such as AirPods at the same time.

However, on the eve of the launch event, one of the existing Apple Watch models — the Apple Watch SE 3 — has already been discontinued on Apple's official website.

According to MacRumors, no matter how you configure any version of the Apple Watch SE 3, at the final step, Apple's official website will display that the model is "currently out of stock", whether you choose home delivery or in-store pickup at an Apple Store.

Apple generally does not clear inventory before a product is ready to be replaced.

However, the most puzzling thing this time is that there are no rumours about the Apple Watch SE 4 in the market at all.

On the contrary, only two new products are currently expected by external parties: the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4.

The current out-of-stock situation may be a system glitch and could hopefully return to normal in the short term. However, based on the current situation, it does seem to suggest that a new generation of products may make its debut tomorrow.

We will continue to update the latest availability status of the Apple Watch SE 3.
